question: Which additional lunar mansions are to be honored together with the Pūrvā group?
premises: Certain lunar mansions are declared worthy of honor.
They are included together with the Pūrvā mansions.
inference: Śatabhiṣak and Viśākhā, together with the Pūrvā mansions, are to be honored.
uncertainties: pūrvajaiḥ refers to the group of Pūrvā nakṣatras, but the exact set is contextually understood.
plain_english: Śatabhiṣak and Viśākhā, together with the Pūrvā mansions, are to be honored.
